Subject: POC Kickoff & Timeline — Redwood trial for Acme Industries

Hi Alex / Priya — thanks again for a great discovery call today. Quick recap and proposed plan to get the POC moving: 

TL;DR / proposed next steps
- Confirm success criteria below
- Kickoff call week of Oct 12 (see proposed slots)
- We’ll send a short SOW + plan and a calendar invite once timing is confirmed

Success criteria (please confirm / edit):
1) Latency: 95th percentile inference latency under 350ms for your typical 512-token prompts across 10k daily requests
2) Quality: baseline prompt-set pass rate >= 90% on the NPS-style rubric we discussed (accuracy + relevance)
3) Cost: demonstration of ~30% unit-cost reduction vs your current hosting baseline with our batching/caching config
4) Integration: embedding-based search integrated into your staging app and validated by QA team

POC scope & ownership
- Redwood (Marissa + Ethan): environment setup, model selection recommendation, technical kickoff, weekly check-ins, final readout
- Acme (Alex + Priya): provide sample prompt sets, access to staging environment, evaluation owners, and success metric sign-off

Proposed timeline (flexible):
- Oct 12: Technical kickoff (1 hour) — alignment on infra, data, and access
- Oct 13–22: Setup & model tuning, initial runs
- Oct 23–Nov 5: Evaluation window (2 weeks) with weekly check-ins
- Nov 8: Final readout + next steps

Attachments: POC_SOW.pdf (draft), Redwood_POC_Template.xlsx (evaluation sheet)

Can you confirm the success criteria and whether Oct 12 (10am PT) or Oct 13 (9am PT) works for the kickoff? Once you confirm, we’ll lock the calendar and circulate the invite.

Thanks — looking forward to getting started.

—
Marissa Cole
